lesson_text: C19+L22 (60/40) with DD 12/28 wider brake yields SR 0.867, CAGR 15.29%, MDD 31.83%. Compared to parent STR_1566 (no DD: SR 0.927, CAGR 20.1%, MDD 47.6% hard fail) and sibling STR_1567 (DD 8/20: SR 0.834, CAGR 12.9%, MDD 32.0%), DD 12/28 is the optimal width — preserves 15.3pp CAGR (vs 12.9% with 8/20) while compressing MDD by 15.8pp. However still 0.7pp short of CAGR 16% target. Lesson: DD brake width is a CAGR-MDD tradeoff curve. 12/28 sits at a sweet spot but the underlying 2F signal (C19+L22) needs stronger alpha to push past Grade A threshold with any DD overlay.
core_reference: L-801 DD width lesson. STR_1566 parent (hard fail). STR_1567 DD 8/20 comparison. DD brake width optimization within C9 compliance.
